scope: Independent QA review of canonical run 2026-11-16T17-35-10-569Z-99f951, its actual saved screenshots, test/DOM/network evidence and current relevant product source. Other specialist drafts were not read. This reviewer assessed shared browser execution evidence and did not independently re-execute every journey.
strengths: A/B assertions confirm explicit staged pantry saving, distinct Van otthon/Kevés/Elfogyott values, quantity-free custom items, working Undo and persistence after refresh.

C rejects zero quantity, normalizes 0.5 l to 500 ml, preserves notes and purchase checkmarks, and finishes purchased items while retaining unchecked ones. The overlay finding remains a real interruption to this otherwise completed path.
D ingredient screenshots and assertions separate recipe requirements from shopping amounts, preview before mutation, preserve recipe links and avoid invented pantry availability.
E confirms cooking step and timer restoration after reload, completion through SQL readback and another refresh, and no silent pantry deduction.

F screenshots and checks distinguish proposals, clarification, receipts and failure. Injected save failure retains the proposal and unchanged cart; 503/retry, empty response and real chunked HTTP rendering are exercised using canned outputs.
G preserves the partner’s 3 l quantity after a stale 2 l edit, despite the incorrect receipt. No real invitation was submitted.
The supplemental localStorage quota failure preserves the prior in-memory and stored pantry value and gives truthful failure feedback.
limitations: The run reports 135 passed and 4 failed assertions with no harness errors. The conflicting success receipt is visible in evidence but is not asserted by G-conflict, which checks only quantity.

All identities, households and application data are synthetic. PGlite executes repository SQL under synthetic authenticated roles; deployed Supabase, production RLS and real OAuth/email were not validated.

AI outputs are canned contracts. Real reasoning, voice recognition, providers, latency and generated-image quality remain untested. F failure replaces saveVoiceState; the separate pantry probe throws an actual localStorage quota exception.
Realtime WebSockets and outbound traffic are blocked. Shared updates are verified through SQL RPC and refresh paths, not production realtime or physical devices.

Logs contain blocked Google Fonts, an intentional AI 503, aborted image loads, conversation_page 400 responses and the expected household conflict 400. Error response bodies for conversation_page are absent, so those responses cannot independently establish a product defect or a clean conversation-history backend.
The Python startup defect is confirmed for the documented local path only; deployed static builds were not tested.

Contact sheets cover A–F and narrow overview/pantry/list/recipe/chat layouts. Detailed responsive/axe assessment belongs to the other specialists. No screen-reader or full accessibility-compliance claim is made.
No application source, production data, authentication settings, commit, push or deployment was changed by this review.

findings.title: Documented Python startup refuses required entry scripts
findings.affectedScreen: Initial application load in documented local preview
reproductionSteps: Start python3 server.py from the repository as documented in README.
Open its loopback URL in a fresh browser without invoking AI or authentication.
Inspect entry-script responses and main content.
findings.expectedBehavior: All entry scripts load and current onboarding/main content initializes.
findings.actualBehavior: The actual Handler probe returns 404 for 12 required scripts including cooking-session.js, quantity-model.js, persistence.js and onboarding-model.js, then records require/CompanionModel/OnboardingModel errors. The screenshot shows the shell and empty main content. The static allowlist omits these assets.
findings.userImpact: Local users and developers following documented startup cannot reliably enter the current application or test its journeys.

evidence.description: Actual Handler probe: 12 missing entry scripts and four page errors.
Initial preview has empty main content.

findings.recommendedSolution: Keep a restricted static-file policy but align its public entry-asset list with index.html and the build manifest. Require the existing entry-script loading test for local-preview changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Every index.html entry script returns 200 and non-empty JavaScript from the Python server.
Fresh context renders current onboarding/main content without missing-global errors.
Private files and traversal paths remain inaccessible.
regressionTests: Run a fresh-browser startup check against the actual Python Handler.
notes: Confirmed local-preview defect; no inference about production/static deployment.

findings.title: Rejected shared quantity edit still reports attempted value as saved
findings.affectedScreen: Shared shopping list after concurrent edits
findings.routeOrComponent: shopping-mode-ui.js editItem/feedback and household.js cart outbox
reproductionSteps: Use two synthetic accounts in one test household with Tej on the shopping list.
Open the Tej editor in both accounts with the old quantity.
Save 3 l in the second account and wait for its outbox to settle.
Save 2 l from the first account’s stale editor and wait for conflict recovery.
findings.expectedBehavior: Keep the newer shared value and explicitly report that the attempted edit was not applied. Completed-action feedback describes the persisted result.
findings.actualBehavior: The row correctly shows Tej 3 l and a toast says the fresh shared list was retained, while a simultaneous receipt says Mentve: 2 l with Visszavonás. editCart returns true after local outbox persistence and schedules sync; editItem immediately emits success. Later rejected intents refresh the row without retracting the receipt.
findings.userImpact: A household member can believe a rejected change succeeded and act on the wrong shopping quantity. The conflicting messages undermine shared-state trust. No lost partner update was observed.

evidence.description: Row shows 3 l, conflict toast retains fresh data, receipt claims 2 l.
DOM confirms the contradictory messages coexist.
G-conflict checks only retained quantity, not receipt truthfulness.

findings.recommendedSolution: Track feedback per cart intent. Distinguish pending local save from confirmed shared save, and resolve receipts from the server/rebase outcome. Replace misleading success text and remove irrelevant Undo after rejection while preserving conflict protection.
acceptanceCriteria: A rejected 2 l edit never leaves Saved: 2 l after sync settles on 3 l.
Pending/failed shared saves are distinct from confirmed saves.
Accepted edits show the persisted quantity in their receipt.
Undo never claims to reverse a rejected edit and preserves partner data.
regressionTests: Extend G-conflict to assert settled receipt text and SQL/current state.
Check receipts for accepted saves, revision rejection, network delay and sync failure.
notes: Data conflict recovery is correct; this finding concerns false success and receipt lifecycle.

findings.title: Save receipt covers mobile Start shopping action
findings.affectedScreen: Shopping planning at 390 × 844 after quantity save
reproductionSteps: At 390 × 844 add Tej, Kenyér and Alma to the synthetic list.
Edit Tej to 0.5 l and save; remove Kenyér while the receipt remains.
Try Boltban vagyok in the fixed bottom action area.
findings.expectedBehavior: The primary shopping action remains visible and reachable while save/Undo feedback is shown.
findings.actualBehavior: The Mentve: 500 ml receipt covers Boltban vagyok; the center-point hit test fails. The run waits for the receipt to disappear before entering shopping mode. Source gives the receipt a 10-second lifetime.
findings.userImpact: Users finishing list edits temporarily lose the primary action for starting shopping.

evidence.description: Launch occupies y=705–761 and receipt Undo y=702–746.
C-start-reachable fails; later steps complete after waiting.

findings.recommendedSolution: Place transient feedback clear of the contextual action dock or reserve its layout space. Use measured overlay positioning so status messages cannot cover the next task action.
acceptanceCriteria: Boltban vagyok stays visible and pointer-reachable during save feedback at 320, 375 and 390 px.
Undo does not overlap navigation or primary actions.
Entering shopping requires no timeout wait.
regressionTests: Run immediate post-save and post-delete hit tests at mobile widths.
Use normal clicks; do not force clicks or hide feedback in tests.

findings.title: Pantry search silently ignores selected availability filter
findings.affectedScreen: Pantry search with Van otthon selected
reproductionSteps: Open a fresh synthetic pantry with empty stock.
findings.expectedBehavior: Results respect selected availability, or visible and accessible state explicitly explains expansion to the whole catalog.
findings.actualBehavior: Van otthon remains pressed and the count becomes 13 while all results are Nincs jelölve. matching bypasses availability whenever query() is non-empty without changing selected state.
findings.userImpact: Users searching what is at home must reinterpret unmarked catalog matches; filter and count do not reliably describe the shown scope.

evidence.description: Pressed home filter above unknown catalog matches.
Accessible snapshot confirms selected home and Nincs jelölve results.
Empty stock plus 13 unknown search results.

findings.recommendedSolution: Search within selected scope with an explicit catalog search/add option, or visibly switch to an All ingredients search state. Preserve easy addition without suggesting unknown items are at home.
acceptanceCriteria: Empty home scope does not label catalog results as belonging to it.
Catalog expansion is explicit visually and accessibly.
Clearing search restores consistent filter and count.
regressionTests: Search absent items under Home/Low/Used up and assert scope consistency.
Confirm catalog/add remains available without premature mutation.

findings.title: Saving pantry availability drops keyboard focus out of dialog
findings.affectedScreen: Pantry details after keyboard status save
reproductionSteps: Search Tej and open its details.
Focus Kevés and activate with Enter.
After save, inspect activeElement and press Escape.
findings.expectedBehavior: Focus stays on a useful dialog control after update and returns to the current ingredient opener or predictable nearby control on close.
findings.actualBehavior: The saved value is 1 and the dialog remains open, but activeElement is BODY. Escape closes the dialog and leaves BODY focused. Both underlying catalog and dialog content are replaced without restoring focused elements.
findings.userImpact: Keyboard users lose their position during routine pantry editing. This is observed focus loss, not proof of screen-reader announcement failure.

evidence.description: BODY after save with open dialog and BODY after Escape.
Updated Kevés state with dialog still open.
Dialog and pressed Kevés are in accessible snapshot.

findings.recommendedSolution: Preserve or restore the active status control across dialog updates. On close resolve the current opener again, with a predictable fallback if filtering removes the item.
acceptanceCriteria: After status save focus stays visible inside the open dialog.
Escape returns to current opener or a predictable fallback.
Focus also works after failed save and list rerender.
regressionTests: Use real Enter/Escape after success, failure and rerender.
Test updated items removed by current filter.
notes: A passing no-change open/close test does not cover this update path. Native-dialog BODY focus at a Tab-cycle boundary is not used as evidence here.
